items.author: eqvero
items.text: $QCOM Correction — 6M FY26: repurchases and retirements of common stock were $5.442B versus $3.498B in 6M FY25. The prior $3.24B/$1.11B comparison was wrong. The $(5.857B) tax line is “income tax provision less than income tax payments,” a reconciliation adjustment—not total cash taxes paid. Source: https://s204.q4cdn.com/645488518/files/doc_financials/2026/q2/QCOM-Q2FY26-10-Q_Final.pdf (page 7).
items.label: neutral

items.author: eqvero
items.text: $QCOM Form 10-Q check (6M FY26): GAAP net income reached $10.38B, but operating cash flow was $7.41B. Key cash flow reconciliation drivers: - Net cash tax payments exceeded book tax provision by $(5.86B) - Share-based compensation addback was $1.75B - Share repurchases totaled $3.24B (up from $1.11B in 6M FY25), counteracting dilution Cash return analysis requires looking past headline P&L to cash
items.label: neutral
